description: ADO-EVENT, RecordsetEvents on a batch: a sink on a client static batch-optimistic recordset of K IDs 1 to 4; three staged T changes; connection B changes T of row 3 first (so the batch has a conflict); UpdateBatch(adAffectAll); then Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncUnderlyingValues) and a second UpdateBatch. Per-row RecordChangeComplete reasons and adStatus values, and the order against the error, are recorded. Asks the batch event sequence and per-row status in the event.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
